subject: Physics
question: When a heavy current is passed through a straight vertical wire, compass needles placed around it on a cardboard set themselves:

question: A magnetic field is said to have a strength of one tesla if it exerts a force of one newton on:

optionD: One metre length of a conductor carrying 10 A current
